title: the gpu suites' key to the local model servers

findings.claim: the gpu suites sent no key to the guarded model servers: every model-quality call was a 401
findings.severity_basis: the gpu stage cannot pass on a box whose model servers want the key, so rc1 line 1 cannot hold
findings.fix: tb_testkit.eval_key.eval_client sends TB_LLM_EVAL_KEY to a local endpoint only; tests/unit/test_eval_key_h113.py

findings.claim: the judge suite's real-model test was always skipped in the gpu stage: it read TB_JUDGE_LLM_URL, which the stage never set
findings.severity_basis: the judge's agreement with a real model was never measured by the set while the stage read green
findings.fix: tools.full_set's gpu stage sets TB_JUDGE_LLM_URL and TB_JUDGE_MODEL from --llm-url and --llm-model
findings.from: reading tools/full_set.py and tests/unit/test_judge_tier.py for card H-113, 2026-11-24

findings.claim: an endpoint named by a dotted host name is not local by this card's definition, so the key is refused for it
findings.severity_basis: by design: the walk names the endpoint by a loopback or private address or the service name
findings.fix: not in this card: widening local needs a ruling
